item.title: Creating a Cartoon-Style Circular Fade-to-Black Transition in UE5
item.description: While developing my platformer game a while ago, I wanted to add a classic circular fade-to-black transition for when the player dies — similar to what you might see in cartoons or 3D Mario games.
